description:
This process begins with monitoring inventory levels in a warehouse or store.
When stock reaches a predefined threshold, an automated alert or manual check signals the need to reorder.
The procurement team then places an order with suppliers, considering factors like cost, delivery time, and supplier reliability.
Once the order is placed, the inventory system updates with expected delivery dates.
Upon receiving the stock, it is inspected for quality, recorded in the system, and placed on shelves or in storage.
The process ends when the inventory levels are updated after the restock is complete.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Replenishment" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/inventory-replenishment">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Inventory_Replenishment" name="Inventory Replenishment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Replenishment">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Inventory_System" name="Inventory system">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Replenishment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Monitor_Inventory</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Threshold_Reached</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Reorder_Signal_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Automated_Alert</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Update_Expected_Delivery</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Update_Inventory_Levels</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Procurement_Team" name="Procurement team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Reorder_Signal_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Place_Order</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Warehouse_Staff" name="Warehouse staff">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Manual_Stock_Check</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_Stock_Received</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Inspect_Quality</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Record_Stock</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Place_On_Shelves</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Restock_Complete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Replenishment" name="Monitoring started"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Monitor_Inventory" name="Monitor inventory levels"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Threshold_Reached" name="Stock reached threshold?" default="Flow_Threshold_Not_Reached"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Reorder_Signal_Split" name="Reorder signal type" default="Flow_To_Automated_Alert"/>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_Automated_Alert" name="Send automated reorder alert"/>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_Manual_Stock_Check" name="Perform manual stock check"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Reorder_Signal_Join" name="Reorder signal raised"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Place_Order" name="Place order with supplier"/>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_Update_Expected_Delivery" name="Update inventory system with expected delivery dates"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_Stock_Received" name="Stock received"/>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_Inspect_Quality" name="Inspect stock quality"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Record_Stock" name="Record received stock in system"/>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_Place_On_Shelves" name="Place stock on shelves or in storage"/>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_Update_Inventory_Levels" name="Update inventory levels after restock"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Restock_Complete" name="Restock complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_To_Monitor" sourceRef="StartEvent_Replenishment" targetRef="Task_Monitor_Inventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Monitor_To_Threshold" sourceRef="Task_Monitor_Inventory" targetRef="Gateway_Threshold_Reached"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Threshold_Not_Reached" sourceRef="Gateway_Threshold_Reached" targetRef="Task_Monitor_Inventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Threshold_Reached" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Threshold_Reached" targetRef="Gateway_Reorder_Signal_Split">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stockReachedThreshold}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_To_Automated_Alert" name="Automated alert" sourceRef="Gateway_Reorder_Signal_Split" targetRef="Task_Automated_Alert"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_To_Manual_Check" name="Manual check" sourceRef="Gateway_Reorder_Signal_Split" targetRef="Task_Manual_Stock_Check">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${manualCheckRequired}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Alert_To_Join" sourceRef="Task_Automated_Alert" targetRef="Gateway_Reorder_Signal_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Manual_To_Join" sourceRef="Task_Manual_Stock_Check" targetRef="Gateway_Reorder_Signal_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_To_Place_Order" sourceRef="Gateway_Reorder_Signal_Join" targetRef="Task_Place_Order"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Place_Order_To_Update_Delivery" sourceRef="Task_Place_Order" targetRef="Task_Update_Expected_Delivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_Delivery_To_Received" sourceRef="Task_Update_Expected_Delivery" targetRef="Event_Stock_Received"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Received_To_Inspect" sourceRef="Event_Stock_Received" targetRef="Task_Inspect_Quality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inspect_To_Record" sourceRef="Task_Inspect_Quality" targetRef="Task_Record_Stock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Record_To_Shelves" sourceRef="Task_Record_Stock" targetRef="Task_Place_On_Shelves"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shelves_To_Update_Levels" sourceRef="Task_Place_On_Shelves" targetRef="Task_Update_Inventory_Levels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_Levels_To_End" sourceRef="Task_Update_Inventory_Levels" targetRef="EndEvent_Restock_Complete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
